wordsvideo.title: {count} Words to Sound Smarter
wordsvideo.subtitle: كلمات إنجليزية ستبهر بها الجميع
wordsvideo.words:
Resilient | مَرِن، سريع التعافي | /rɪˈzɪliənt/ | able to recover quickly from difficulties | Kids are often more resilient than we think.
Overwhelmed | مُنهَك، غارق في المهام | /ˌəʊvəˈwelmd/ | having too much to deal with at once | I felt overwhelmed by all the emails.
Grateful | مُمتنّ | /ˈɡreɪtfl/ | feeling thankful for something | I'm so grateful for your help.
Reluctant | متردّد، غير راغب | /rɪˈlʌktənt/ | not willing to do something | He was reluctant to ask for help.
Thrive | يزدهر، ينمو بقوة | /θraɪv/ | to grow or develop very well | Plants thrive in warm sunlight.
Genuine | حقيقي، صادق | /ˈdʒenjuɪn/ | real and sincere, not fake | She has a genuine smile.
